privacy: Raw issue text, actor identifiers, and commit emails remain in ignored local storage. This file contains aggregate, identity-free collection metadata only.
known_limitations: The public API cannot enumerate the complete collaborator roster without repository write-level access; the May 18 roster is retained only as a sensitivity definition.
Content deleted before retrieval cannot be recovered, and bodies edited after the cutoff are current representations rather than historical body snapshots.
Current open-PR file lists can include changes after the cutoff; merged-by-cutoff PRs are stable for benchmark task-source analysis.
Commit timestamps do not reveal when a commit was first pushed to an open pull request; cutoff filtering uses committedAt.
Project-board-only and notification/bookkeeping timeline events are outside the engineering-maintenance event scope.
